citation.display: Henry David Thoreau. From “November 19, 1850.” The Journal of Henry David Thoreau. Walden Edition, The Writings of Henry David Thoreau. Ed. Bradford Torrey. Boston: Houghton, Mifflin and Co. 1906. 104-105.

firstLine: Each season is thus drawn out and lingers in certain localities, as the birds and insects know very well. …
